cohort: 75 term newborns with birth asphyxia and Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy (HIE) clinical stages I, II, or III, admitted to the Neonatology section of a Department of Pediatrics.
finding: Bilateral basal ganglia and/or bilateral thalami lesions were the predominant finding in stage 3 HIE, while Periventricular leukomalacia was the predominant finding in stage 2 HIE.
cross-section timing: within the first 2 weeks after birth
